text_block_list.text: At the academy, I spotted Smart Falcon and Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaaah... I just can't win at all. Falco is totally hopeless... ✨

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: My, my, that's rare. To see Falco-san looking so down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well... the thing is, it's actually about a video game...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Lately, there's this super realistic VR boxing game that's really popular, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone's raving about how it trains your rhythm and sharpens your footwork, so Falco tried it out on the Umalator too, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I just couldn't read the AI opponent's movement rhythm at all, and I lost bad...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I used to be pretty confident in my rhythm, but... maybe my training as an Umadol isn't enough yet... ✨

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm... When it comes to rhythm, you see, rather than trying to read and match your opponent's, you ought to set the beat yourself.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: For instance, even when throwing the same old jab, you vary the rhythm up, like this—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: A single jab... into a jab, jab! Duck under—and deliver the real straight punch!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...And there you have it. In boxing, just knowing that can help you put up quite a fight.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa! Th-That was amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...U-Um! Acute-san! Could you teach Falco more?! The secrets of boxing! ✨
...And thus, an impromptu boxing master-disciple duo was born. After that, I started seeing the two of them sparring and training regularly—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Your straight punch was a wee bit sluggish there. Try to throw it with the feel of overtaking your jab.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Y-Yessir! ✨

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Whether attacking or dodging, keep linking your movements together... If you can keep moving non-stop all the way until the round ends, you'll be in great shape.

And so, Smart Falcon improved by leaps and bounds.
She racked up win after win in the boxing game—

text_block_list.name: Player Student A
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear?! Looks like Falco-chan is
challenging the Champ on the highest difficulty mode!

text_block_list.name: Player Student B
text_block_list.text:
Against that undefeated COM...?! 
We can't just sit here!
Let's go watch right now!

text_block_list.name: Champ COM
text_block_list.text:
—HAHAHAHAHA! Easy fight!
I'll finish this in the next round!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
S-So strong...! My HP is already almost out...!
Can Falco really not win this...?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—No way. Your opponent is acting tough, but ya see...
Their swings are gettin' wider. Their rhythm is falling apart.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Know why? ...They're getting impatient.
All because of your tenacity, Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...An unbreakable heart. The will to see things through.
I've been watchin' real close, and I know
all about your greatest strengths, Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's in the ring or on the racetrack...
Those qualities are the weapons that will lead you to victory.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Stick to your usual rhythm, your usual way of fightin'.
Have faith in yourself, the same Falco-san as always.
Now then... go get 'em.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Advance! Attack! Dodge!
Move to... Falco's own rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Champ COM
text_block_list.text:
............Gh!
Easssy... FIGHHHTTT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—Now's your chance!
Ducking to dodge—and then!

text_block_list.name: Falco & Acute
text_block_list.text: Finishing move... Right straight punch!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Falco-san.
How does it feel right now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
............ Becoming the champ makes me
super happy... but.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
More than that... I'm just so glad
I got to box together with you, Acute-san...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hohoho. ...The pleasure was all mine, dear.

...Wait, was becoming the champ even the original goal?
Brushing such unrefined thoughts aside—
I gave the two of them a heartfelt round of applause.
